limits: Complete member coverage for all 36 official PyPI 0.17.3 archives. All 35 wheels have identical numerical/source payloads; five documentation/notice paths have CRLF-only variants, recorded by exact hash. This is an evidence inventory, not Debian acceptance or a legal finding about copyrightability.

Open declarations from existing metadata are distinguished from fresh confirmation by an original rights holder. No license is inferred from public access, scientific validation, article citation, file extension or directory.
Local author grants are a separate overlay and are not misrepresented as notices shipped in 0.17.3. Maintainer-reported permission is not independently authenticated correspondence.

Every EOS record and material structure/diffraction component is enumerated, including inline data. Unknown terms do not establish that numerical facts are restricted or that they may be redistributed.
The source archive contains historical reports and generated plots with mixed provenance. MIT covers contributor narrative/code, not automatically every embedded source element.

Rust inventory covers the all-target normal/build dependency graph from Cargo.lock. Build tools are included; dev-only packages excluded. This is not an exact linked-code or Rust standard-library inventory for every wheel.
External Python dependencies are installed separately, not bundled by virtue of Requires-Dist; native dependency notice compliance remains a separate recorded action.

This inventory records the immutable published 0.17.3 release plus current data/rights overlays. Author declarations and Ma DOCX exclusion shipped in 0.17.4. Subsequent Fei image removal, numerical plot replacements, and Tateno workbook/Chidester ZIP exclusions apply only to later builds; 0.17.4 archives remain unchanged. Inventory tooling and reports were added after 0.17.3 and are not claimed to be files in its archived distributions.

The subsequent CIF review records current COD CC0 declarations against matched source files without rewriting their legacy headers. He (2023) thesis/table reuse terms remain unresolved; failed live repository requests are not licensing evidence. Historical release-state classifications are retained.

After 0.17.4 the He brucite CIF and copied structural values were replaced by CC0 COD 1000054. Original evidence and the obsolete pre-disposition card are private; published archives and all EOS numerical evidence are unchanged.

The 5 November numerical redistribution review separately records factual-content admission decisions. These do not turn unknown source terms into open grants. The newly verified Zenodo source grant and iridium article NC/ND declaration are current-only overlays.
